name: Bolna
positioning: Bolna is a voice AI agent platform and API focused on India, with multilingual support for Indian languages plus global telephony options.

pricing.model: Prepaid wallet with a flat per-minute rate that bundles STT, LLM and TTS on a curated model list, plus telephony and a platform fee; pilot and enterprise volume plans.
pricing.headline: Standard rate from 6.0 cents per minute (USD) on pay-as-you-go, falling to about 4.5 cents at the largest top-up tier; one-time pilot packs at about 4.2 to 4.6 cents per minute.
planNotes: Pay-as-you-go: buy credits from $10 to $5,000; the pricing page slider shows 6.00 cents/min at $15 down to 4.51 cents/min at the highest tier shown.
Pilot plan (one-time): $300 for 6,500 minutes (~4.6 cents/min) or $500 for 12,000 minutes (~4.2 cents/min), up to 25 concurrent calls, billed in 30-second pulses, one month of dedicated support.
Enterprise: custom volume pricing, dedicated account manager.

Docs say the flat rate covers transcription, LLM and TTS on preferred models; telephony is charged per minute by the carrier and Bolna adds its own per-minute platform component. The docs do not state whether the 6 cents headline already includes the platform component or telephony.
Pricing figures were seen on the pricing page (including its FAQ) and the pilot docs page; the pay-as-you-go 6 cents figure is on the pricing page only (single-source).
whatIsExtra: Telephony charges by the carrier (varies by country and provider)
Models outside the preferred list billed at variable usage rates
Premium voices and international numbers priced above the standard bundle
Bolna platform fee per minute (see docs; relationship to headline rate not stated)

strengths.claim: Built for Indian languages and accents: 10+ Indian languages including Hinglish, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu, with India or US data residency options.
Flexible telephony: connect your own Twilio, Plivo, Exotel or Vobiz account or a custom SIP trunk, or buy a number from Bolna.
Bring-your-own-keys for LLM, TTS, STT and tools so you can pay providers directly.
Low-friction entry: $5 free credits, pay-as-you-go from $10, and discounted pilot packs with weekly 1:1 support.
Developer surface includes REST API, CLI, MCP server, SDKs and an open-source core, plus Zapier, n8n and Make integrations.

limitations.claim: The current version does not sign webhook or tool-call requests (no HMAC); Bolna recommends allow-listing its three source IP addresses instead.
Agents stop making calls when prepaid credits run out unless auto top-up is configured.
HIPAA, SOC 2 and GDPR certifications are not listed on the docs security page; customers are asked to contact support for those.

compliance.note: The docs security page does not state HIPAA, SOC 2 or GDPR status and directs customers to support for those; it does state TLS 1.2+, encryption at rest for agent configuration, India and US data residency, and an independent VAPT assessment rated A+ (self-reported).

telephony.providedNumbers: Bolna can provide a dedicated number; customers can also connect Twilio, Plivo, Exotel, Vobiz or their own SIP trunk (BYOT). Plivo is described as the default for most deployments.

stepsToLeave: List and view agents through the REST API, the CLI (bolna agents list/view) or the MCP server.
Call history and recordings are in each execution record; docs say to contact support for the recording retention policy.
Numbers bought from Bolna versus numbers on your own provider account: docs describe your own provider accounts staying under your control; porting of Bolna-purchased numbers was not documented.

bestFor: Teams running high-volume inbound or outbound calling, especially in India or in Indian languages, who want a managed per-minute platform with a wide range of telephony and model options.
